verses.sanskrit: उतथ्य उवाच। कालवर्षी च पर्जन्यो धर्मचारी च पार्थिवः। सम्पद्यदेषा भवति सा बिभर्ति सुखं प्रजाः॥१॥
verses.english: Tuladhara said See with your own eyes, O Jajali, who, amongst the good or otherwise, have followed this path of duty which I have spoken of! You will understand properly how the truth stands.

verses.sanskrit: यो न जानाति हर्तुं वा वस्त्राणां रजको मलम्। रक्तानां वा शोधयितुं यथा नास्ति तथैव सः॥२॥
verses.english: See, many birds are roving in the sky! Amongst them are those who were brought up on your head, as also many hawks and many others of different kinds.

verses.sanskrit: एवमेतद्द्विजेन्द्राणां क्षत्रियाणां विशां तथा। शूद्रश्चतुर्थो वर्णानां नानाकर्मस्ववस्थितः॥३॥
verses.english: See, O Brahmana, those birds have got their wings and legs for entering their respective nests. Call them, O twice-born one.

verses.sanskrit: कर्म शूद्रे कृषिर्वैश्ये दण्डनीतिश्च राजनि। ब्रह्मचर्यं तपो मन्त्राः सत्यं चापि द्विजातिषु॥४॥
verses.english: There, those birds, treated affectionately by you, are showing their love for you who are their father! Forsooth, you are their father, O Jajali! Do you call your children!

verses.sanskrit: तेषां यः क्षत्रियो वेद वस्त्राणामिव शोधनम्। शीलदोषान्विनिर्हर्तुं स पिता स प्रजापतिः॥५॥
verses.english: Bhishma continued-Then those birds, summoned by Jajali, answered according to the dictates of that religion which preaches abstention from injury to any creature.

verses.sanskrit: कृतं त्रेता द्वापरं च कलिश्च भरतर्षभ। राजवृत्तानि सर्वाणि राजैव युगमुच्यते॥६॥
verses.english: All acts that done without injuring any creature come to use both here and hereafter. Those acts, however, that injure others, destroy faith, and faith being destroyed, brings ruin on the destroyer.

verses.sanskrit: चातुर्वर्ण्यं तथा वेदाश्चातुराश्रम्यमेव च। सर्वं प्रमुह्यते ह्येतद्यदा राजा प्रमाद्यति॥७॥
verses.english: The sacrifice of those who regard equally both acquisition and non-acquisition, who are endued with faith, who are self controlled, who have tranquil minds, and who celebrate sacrifices from a sense of duty yield fruits.

verses.sanskrit: अग्नित्रेता त्रयी विद्या यज्ञाश्च सहदक्षिणाः। सर्व एव प्रमाद्यन्ति यदा राजा प्रमाद्यति॥८॥
verses.english: Faith in Brahma is the daughter of the SunGod, O twice-bom one. She is the protectress and the giver of good birth. Faith is superior to the merit begotten by recitations and meditation.

verses.sanskrit: राजैव कर्ता भूतानां राजैव च विनाशकः। धर्मात्मा यः स कर्ता स्यादधर्मात्मा विनाशकः॥९॥
verses.english: An act vitiated by faulty speech is saved by Faith. An act sullied by defect of mind is saved by Faith. But neither speech nor mind can save an act which is sullied by want of Faith.

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञो भार्याश्च पुत्राश्च बान्धवाः सुहृदस्तथा। समेत्य सर्वे शोचन्ति यदा राजा प्रमाद्यति॥१०॥
verses.english: Men who know the past recite in this connection the following verse sung by Brahman. The gods regard as equal the offerings in sacrifices of a person who is pure but wanting in Faith, and of another who is impure but has Faith. After mature consideration the gods have considered equal the food, again, of a person conversant with the Vedas but miserly in conduct, and that of a usurer who is liberal in conduct.

verses.sanskrit: हस्तिनोऽश्वाश्च गावश्चाप्युष्ट्राश्वतरगर्दभाः। अधर्मभूते नृपतौ सर्वे सीदन्ति जन्तवः॥११॥
verses.english: The supreme Lord of all creatures, then told them that they had committed a mistake, The food of a liberal person is purified by Faith. The food, however, of the person who has Faith is lost for such want of Faith. The food of a liberal usurer can be accepted but not the food of a miser.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्बलार्थं बलं सृष्टं धात्रा मान्धातरुच्यते। अबलं तु महद्भूतं यस्मिन्सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्॥१२॥
verses.english: Only one person in the world viz., he who has no Faith, is unfit to make offerings to the gods. The food of only such a man is unfit to be eaten. This is the opinion of men who know duties.

verses.sanskrit: यच्च भूतं सम्भजते ये च भूतास्तदन्वयाः। अधर्मस्थे हि नृपतौ सर्वे शोचन्ति पार्थिव॥१३॥
verses.english: Want of Faith is a great sin. Faith is a purifier of sins. Like a snake casting off its slough, the man of Faith succeeds in shaking off all his sins.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्बलस्य च यच्चक्षुर्मुनेराशीविषस्य च। अविषह्यतमं मन्ये मा स्म दुर्बलमासदः॥१४॥
verses.english: The religion of abstention with Faith is superior to all shortcomings of conduct, he who follows Faith, becomes purified.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्बलांस्तात बुध्येथा नित्यमेवाविमानितान्। मा त्वां दुर्बलचक्षूंषि प्रदहेयुः सबान्धवम्॥१५॥
verses.english: What need has such a person of penances, or of conduct, or of endurance? Every man has Faith. Faith, however, is of three sorts, viz., as partaking of the nature of the qualities of goodness, darkness, and ignorance, and according to the nature of Faith which one has, one is named.

verses.sanskrit: न हि दुर्बलदग्धस्य कुले किंचित्प्ररोहते। आमूलं निर्दहन्त्येव मा स्म दुर्बलमासदः॥१६॥
verses.english: Person gifted with goodness and endued with insight into the true import of morality have thus described the subject of duties. We have, on enquiry, got all this from the sage Dharınadarshana.

verses.sanskrit: अबलं वै बलाच्छ्रेयो यच्चातिबलवद्बलम्। बलस्याबलदग्धस्य न किंचिदवशिष्यते॥१७॥
verses.english: O you of great wisdom, adopt Faith, for you will then acquire what is superior. He who believes (in the sayings of the Shrutis), and who acts according to their sense, is, indeed, of righteous soul. O Jajali, he who follows his own path is surely a superior person.

verses.sanskrit: विमानितो हतः क्रुष्टस्त्रातारं चेन्न विन्दति। अमानुषकृतस्तत्र दण्डो हन्ति नराधिपम्॥१८॥
verses.english: Bhishma said After a short time Tuladhara and Jajali, both of whom had been gifted with great wisdom, ascended to heaven and played there in great happiness, having reached their respective places won by their respective deeds. Tuladhara had spoken many truths of this sort.

verses.sanskrit: मा स्म तात रणे स्थित्वा भुञ्जीथा दुर्बलं जनम्। मा त्वां दुर्बलचक्षूंषि दहन्त्वग्निरिवाशयम्॥१९॥
verses.english: That great person understood this religion perfectly. These eternal duties were accordingly declared by him.

verses.sanskrit: यानि मिथ्याभिशस्तानां पतन्त्यश्रूणि रोदताम्। तानि पुत्रान्पशून्घ्नन्ति तेषां मिथ्याभिशंसनात्॥२०॥
verses.english: O son of Kunti, having heard these words of Tuladhara of celebrated energy, the twiceborn Jajali betook himself to tranquillity. In this way many truths of deep sense were spoken by Tuladhara, illustrated by examples for instruction. What other truths do you wish to hear?

verses.sanskrit: यदि नात्मनि पुत्रेषु न चेत्पौत्रेषु नप्तृषु। न हि पापं कृतं कर्म सद्यः फलति गौरिव॥२१॥
यत्राबलो वध्यमानस्त्रातारं नाधिगच्छति। महान्दैवकृतस्तत्र दण्डः पतति दारुणः॥२२॥
verses.english: When a Weak person fails to find a protector the great rod of divine punishment overtakes the king.

verses.sanskrit: युक्ता यदा जानपदा भिक्षन्ते ब्राह्मणा इव। अभीक्ष्णं भिक्षुरूपेण राजानं घ्नन्ति तादृशाः॥२३॥
verses.english: When all the subjects of a king are compelled by distress to live like Brahmanas, by begging, such mendicancy brings destruction upon the king.

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञो यदा जनपदे बहवो राजपूरुषाः। अनयेनोपवर्तन्ते तद्राज्ञः किल्बिषं महत्॥२४॥
verses.english: When all the officers of the king living in the provinces unite together and act unfairly, the king is then said to bring about a state of unredeeming evil upon his kingdom.

verses.sanskrit: यदा युक्त्या नयेदर्थान्कामादर्थवशेन वा। कृपणं याचमानानां तद्राज्ञो वैशसं महत्॥२५॥
verses.english: When the officers of the king extort money, hy unfair mean, or acting from lust or avarice, from persons pitcously praying for mercy, a great destruct' on, jorsooth, be.ails the king.

verses.sanskrit: महान्वृक्षो जायते वर्धते च तं चैव भूतानि समाश्रयन्ति। यदा वृक्षश्छिद्यते दह्यते च तदाश्रया अनिकेता भवन्ति॥२६॥
verses.english: A huge tree, just growing, assumes large proportions, Numberless creatures then come and seek its shelter. When, however, it is cut down or burnt, those who had taken its shelter become all houseless.

verses.sanskrit: यदा राष्ट्रे धर्ममग्र्यं चरन्ति संस्कारं वा राजगुणं ब्रुवाणाः। तैरेवाधर्मश्चरितो धर्ममोहात्तूर्णं जह्यात्सुकृतं दुष्कृतं च॥२७॥
verses.english: When the denizens of a kingdom perform pious acts and all religious rites, and praise the good qualities, of the king, the latter acquires riches. When, however, the residents, out of ignorance forsake righteousness and act unrighteously, the king suffers from misery.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र पापा ज्ञायमानाश्चरन्ति सतां कलिर्विन्दते तत्र राज्ञः। यदा राजा शास्ति नरानशिष्टांस्तदा राज्यं वर्धते भूमिपस्य॥२८॥
verses.english: When sinful men of known acts are allowed to move among the righteous, Kali then overtakes the kings of those kingdoms. When the king punishes all wicked people, his kingdom prospers.

verses.sanskrit: यश्चामात्यान्मानयित्वा यथार्थं मन्त्रे च युद्धे च नृपो नियुंज्यात्। विवर्धते तस्य राष्ट्रं नृपस्य भुंक्ते महीं चाप्यखिलां चिराय॥२९॥
verses.english: Forsooth, the kingdom of that king certainly prospers who honours his ministers and employs them in policy and in battles. Such a king enjoys the wide Earth or ever.

verses.sanskrit: यच्चापि सुकृतं कर्म वाचं चैव सुभाषिताम्। समीक्ष्य पूजयन् राजा धर्मं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम्॥३०॥
verses.english: That king who duly honours at good acts and good speeches acquires great merit.

verses.sanskrit: संविभज्य यदा भुंक्ते नामात्यानवमन्यते। निहन्ति बलिनं दृप्तं स राज्ञो धर्म उच्यते॥३१॥
verses.english: The enjoyment of good things with others, paying proper honours to the ministers, and subjugations of persons who are proud of their strength, are the great duty of a king.

verses.sanskrit: त्रायते हि यदा सर्वं वाचा कायेन कर्मणा। पुत्रस्यापि न मृष्येच्च स राज्ञो धर्म उच्यते॥३२॥
verses.english: Protecting all men by words, body, and deeds, and never forgiving even his offending son himself, form the duty of the king.

verses.sanskrit: संविभज्य यदा भुंक्ते नृपतिर्दुर्बलान्नरान्। तदा भवन्ति बलिनः स राज्ञो धर्म उच्यते॥३३॥
verses.english: The maintenance of the Weak by sharing with them the things he has and thereby increasing their strength, form the duty of the king.

verses.sanskrit: यदा रक्षति राष्ट्राणि यदा दस्यूनपोहति। यदा जयति संग्रामे स राज्ञो धर्म उच्यते॥३४॥
verses.english: Protection of the kingdom, extermination of robbers, and conquest form the duty of the king.

verses.sanskrit: पापमाचरतो यत्र कर्मणा व्याहृतेन वा। प्रियस्यापि न मृष्येत स राज्ञो धर्म उच्यते॥३५॥
verses.english: Not to forgive a person, however dear if he has committe an offence, by act or word, forms the duty of the king.

verses.sanskrit: यदा सारणिकान् राजा पुत्रवत्परिरक्षति। भिनत्ति च न मर्यादां स राज्ञो धर्म उच्यते॥३६॥
verses.english: Protecting those who seek refuge with him as he would protect his own children, and never depriving one of the honours to which he is entitled, form the duty of the king.

verses.sanskrit: यदाऽऽप्तदक्षिणैर्यज्ञैर्यजते श्रद्धयाऽन्वितः। कामद्वेषावनादृत्य स राज्ञो धर्म उच्यते॥३७॥
verses.english: Adoring the gods, with devotion in sacrifices completed by presents, and subduing lust and envy, from the duty of the king.

verses.sanskrit: कृपणानाथवृद्धानां यदाश्रु परिमार्जति। हर्षं संजनयन्नॄणां स राज्ञो धर्म उच्यते॥३८॥
verses.english: Wiping the tears of the distressed, the helpless, and the old, and filling them with joy, form the duty of the king.

verses.sanskrit: विवर्धयति मित्राणि तथारींश्चापि कर्षति। सम्पूजयति साधूंश्च स राज्ञो धर्म उच्यते॥३९॥
verses.english: Advancing friends, weakening enemies, and honouring the good, form the duty of the king.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यं पालयति प्रीत्या नित्यं भूमिं प्रयच्छति। पूजयेदतिथीन्भृत्यान् स राज्ञो धर्म उच्यते॥४०॥
verses.english: Cheerfully adhering to truth, always making presents of land, entertaining guests, and maintaining dependents, form the duty of the king.

verses.sanskrit: निग्रहानुग्रहौ चोभौ यत्र स्यातां प्रतिष्ठितौ। अस्मिन्लोके परे चैव राजा स प्राप्नुते फलम्॥४१॥
verses.english: That king who favours those who deserve favours, and punishes those who deserve chastisement, acquires great merit both here and hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: यमो राजा धार्मिकाणां मान्धातः परमेश्वरः। संयच्छन्भवति प्राणानसंयच्छंस्तु पातुकः॥४२॥
verses.english: The king is Yama himself. He is, O Mandhatri, the god (incarnate) to all righteous persons. By controlling his senses he acquires great riches. By not subduing them he commits sin.

verses.sanskrit: ऋत्विक्पुरोहिताचार्यान्सत्कृत्यानवमन्य च। यदा सम्यक्प्रगृह्णाति स राज्ञो धर्म उच्यते॥४३॥
verses.english: Paying proper honours to Ritwijas and priests and preceptors, and doing them good, form the duty of the king.

verses.sanskrit: यमो यच्छति भूतानि सर्वाण्येवाविशेषतः। तथा राज्ञानुकर्तव्यं यन्तव्या विधिवत्प्रजाः॥४४॥
verses.english: Yama governs all creatures without any distinction. The king should imitate him in his conduct by restraining all his subjects duly.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्राक्षेण राजा हि सर्वथैवोपमीयते। स पश्यति च यं धर्मं स धर्मः पुरुषर्षभ॥४५॥
verses.english: The king is said to resemble the Thousandeyed (Indra). O foremost of men, that which is regarded by the king as Righteousness is accepted as such by all.

verses.sanskrit: अप्रमादेन शिक्षेथाः क्षमां बुद्धिं धृतिं मतिम्। भूतानां चैव जिज्ञासा साध्वसाधु च सर्वदा॥४६॥
verses.english: You should diligently cultivate forgiveness, intelligence, patience and the love of all creatures. You should also determine the strength and weakness of all men and learn to distinguish between right and wrong.

verses.sanskrit: संग्रहः सर्वभूतानां दानं च मधुरं वचः। पौरजानपदाश्चैव गोप्तव्यास्ते यथासुखम्॥४७॥
verses.english: You should behave properly towards all creatures, make gifts, the utter agreeable and sweet words. You should maintain the residents of your city and the provinces in happiness.

verses.sanskrit: न जात्वदक्षो नृपतिः प्रजाः शक्नोति रक्षितुम्। भारो हि सुमहांस्तात राज्यं नाम सुदुष्करम्॥४८॥
verses.english: A king, who is not clever, can never protect his subjects. Sovereignty, O sire, is a very heavy burden.

verses.sanskrit: तद्दण्डविन्नृपः प्राज्ञः शूरः शक्नोति रक्षितुम्। न हि शक्यमदण्डेन क्लीबेनाबुद्धिनाऽपि वा॥४९॥
verses.english: Only that king who is endued with wisdom and courage, and who is a master of the science of punishment, can protect a kingdom. He, on the other hand, who is devoid of energy and intelligence, and who is not versed in the great science, cannot bear the burden of sovereignty.

verses.sanskrit: अभिरूपैः कुले जातैर्दक्षैर्भक्तैर्बहुश्रुतैः। सर्वा बुद्धीः परीक्षेथास्तापसाश्रमिणामपि॥५०॥
verses.english: Helped by ministers of beautiful features and good birth, clever in business, devoted to their masters, and highly learned, you should examine the hearts and acts of all men including the very hermits.

verses.sanskrit: अतस्त्वं सर्वभूतानां धर्मं वेत्स्यसि वै परम्। स्वदेशे परदेशे वा न ते धर्मो विनक्षयति॥५१॥
verses.english: Behaving thus, you will be able to learn the duties of all orders of men. This will help you in observing your own duties whether when you are in your country or when you go to other kingdoms.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादर्थाच्च कामाच्च धर्म एवोत्तरो भवेत्। अस्मिल्लोके परे चैव धर्मात्मा सुखमेधते॥५२॥
verses.english: Amongst these three objects, viz., Virtue, Profit, and Pleasure, Virtue is the foremost. He, who is of virtuous soul, acquires great happiness both here and hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: त्यजन्ति दारान्पुत्रांश्च मनुष्याः परिपूजिताः। संग्रहश्चैव भूतानां दानं च मधुरा च वाक्॥५३॥
verses.english: If men are treated with honour, they can abandon their very wives and sons. By winning over good men, by gifts, sweet words, carefulness, and purity of conduct, a king may acquire for himself great prosperity. Do not, therefore, O Mandhatri, be negligent of these qualities and acts.

verses.sanskrit: अप्रमादश्च शौचं च राज्ञो भूतिकरं महत्। एतेभ्यश्चैव मान्धातः सततं मा प्रमादिथाः॥५४॥
अप्रमत्तो भवेद्राजा छिद्रदर्शी परात्मनोः। नास्य च्छिद्रं परः पश्येच्छिद्रेषु परमन्वियात्॥५५॥
verses.english: The king should never neglect to look after his own weak points as also after those of his foes. He should act in such a way that his enemies may not be able to discover his weak points, and he should himself assail them when theirs are seen.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्वृत्तं वासवस्य यमस्य वरुणस्य च। राजर्षीणां च सर्वेषां तत्त्वमप्यनुपालय॥५६॥
verses.english: In this way Vasava, and Yama, and Varuna and all the great royal sages have acted. Do you follow the same conduct.

verses.sanskrit: तत्कुरुष्व महाराज वृत्तं राजर्षिसेवितम्। आतिष्ठ दिव्यं पन्थानमह्नाय भरतर्षभ॥५७॥
verses.english: Do you, O great king, follow the conduct of those royal sages. Do you soon, O foremost of Bharata's race, follow this heavenly road.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मवृत्तं हि राजानं प्रेत्य चेह च भारत। देवर्षिपितृगन्धर्वाः कीर्तयन्ति महौजसः॥५८॥
verses.english: The gods, the Rishis, the Pitris, and the Gandharvas, possessed of great energy, chant the praises, both here and hereafter, of that king who is righteous!

verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              स एवमुक्तो मान्धाता तेनोतथ्येन भारत। कृतवानविशङ्कश्च एकः प्राप च मेदिनीम्॥५९॥
verses.english: Bhishma said nus spoken to by Utatthya, O Bharata, Mandhatri unhesitatingly did as he as he was directed, and became the soul king of the wide Earth.

verses.sanskrit: भवानपि तथा सम्यङ्मान्धातेव महीपते। धर्मं कृत्वा महीं रक्ष स्वर्गे स्थानमवाप्स्यसि॥६०॥
verses.english: Do you also, O king, act righteously like Mandhatri. You will then, after ruling the Earth, live in heaven!
